# not here. physics.maxAcceleration sets the base drive-side accel cap used by every kart
# regardless of --handicap; the handicap does not touch acceleration or rollingResistance at

maxSteerAngle: 30         # steer input clamp (deg)
  rollingResistance: 0.37   # constant rolling-resistance decel (m/s^2)
  maxSpeed: 36.0            # drive-fade shaping speed (km/h); 0 disables the fade. With p=40 the analytic equilibrium is 35.7 km/h
  driveFadeExponent: 40.0   # fade sharpness; 40 keeps the cap near full until ~34 km/h (effect saturates past ~40; p=20 was the real-kart-telemetry fit)
  skiddingCancelRate: 0.236 # lateral anti-skid coefficient (0.05..1)
  steerDelayTime: 0.07      # steer command dead time (s); real kart cmd->status dead time 0.06-0.07 s
  steerTimeConstant: 0.02   # steer first-order lag (s); smaller = snappier
  maxSteerRate: 60          # steer slew rate (deg/s); real kart sustained hard-limit is 22.8 but 60 chosen as interim (2026-08-03)
